subject: Productize current-host resource admission without creating a second admission authority
decision: Materialize a host bootstrap/admission orchestrator with a root-separated HRB acquire bridge, non-root runtime client, automatic smoke adapter, and generic workload admission command.
rationale: Manual inventory/conformance/issue-lease/raw-JSON choreography is unsuitable as normal product UX.
The Host Resource Broker remains the sole authority for lease issuance, placement acceptance, validation, and conflict decisions.
The orchestrator may discover candidates and prepare requests but cannot mint, sign, validate cryptographically, or override a lease.
Normal application/runtime execution stays non-root after one-time bridge installation.
